applicant.name: Dr. Eva Lindner
applicant.organisation: Nordpharma Austria GmbH, pharmacovigilance and drug safety

purpose: As marketing authorisation holder of an SGLT2 inhibitor we must monitor its real-world safety in older patients and patients with kidney disease (post-authorisation safety study required by the regulator).
question: How many patients are currently on an SGLT2 inhibitor, how many of them are 75 or older and how many have chronic kidney disease, for women and for men?
definitions: SGLT2 inhibitor = ATC code starting with A10BK.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Chronic kidney disease = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with N18.

Report per sex: patients with an active SGLT2 inhibitor, those aged 75 or older, those with chronic kidney disease and the latter as a share of all patients with an active SGLT2 inhibitor in %, one decimal.
